The '''Tragrud system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It only contained one [[Star/Legends|star]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tragrud]].
